This Vladimir was a true man of science, and realized in time that they were creating something terrifying. He secretly began to develop an antidote all by himself. The work was in its final stages, he even synthesized several prototypes! It seems he made one mistake in estimating the length of the virus' incubation period... That is what probably made him the first victim of a project he himself had been involved in. We have reason to believe there's a sample of antidote number 4 in the sealed section. With it, we can recreate the vaccine formula and synthesize more. We can't lose that sample. That's why I had to arrange a deal with that car service mobster to deliver the sample to my group. You'll need to cross from the Lab to the city, and then leave the vaccine at his, uh, workstation.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Vaccine sample IV|vaccine vial]] in [[The Lab]] * Use the transit from [[The Lab]] to [[Streets of Tarkov]] * Stash the [[Vaccine sample IV|vaccine]] under [[Kaban]]'s office on [[Streets of Tarkov]] ==Rewards== * +26,000 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 130,000 Roubles ** 136,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 149,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Medicine case]] {{quote|Your contribution to saving the city is invaluable! It can be found in residential unit no. 7 inside the containment block. A [[TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard]] is required to enter it. The sample has multiple spawns throughout the room. Afterwards you have to [[transit]] to [[Streets of Tarkov]] and stash the sample under [[Kaban]]'s office in the LexOs car dealership. ===[[The Lab]] Sample location in the containment block===
